token.description: A globally unique identifier for this record of an external bank account association. If a program links an external bank account to more than one end-user or to both the program and the end-user, then Lithic will return each record of the association

owner.description: Legal Name of the business or individual who owns the external account. This will appear in statements

last_four.description: The last 4 digits of the bank account. Derived by Lithic from the account number passed

name.description: The nickname for this External Bank Account

currency.description: currency of the external account 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code

country.description: The country that the bank account is located in using ISO 3166-1. We will only accept USA bank accounts e.g., USA

account_token.description: Indicates which Lithic account the external account is associated with. For external accounts that are associated with the program, account_token field returned will be null

created.description: An ISO 8601 string representing when this funding source was added to the Lithic account.

company_id.description: Optional field that helps identify bank accounts in receipts

dob.description: Date of Birth of the Individual that owns the external bank account
dob.title: Date of Birth

verification_failed_reason.description: Optional free text description of the reason for the failed verification. For ACH micro-deposits returned, this field will display the reason return code sent by the ACH network

verification_attempts.description: The number of attempts at verification

financial_account_token.description: The financial account token of the operating account to fund the micro deposits
